expo.name: Scam Checker
expo.description: Paste a suspicious text, email, or photo of a letter and get a plain-English answer: is it a scam or is it safe?

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scam Checker uses your camera to take a photo of a suspicious message or letter so it can be checked.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Scam Checker uses your photo library so you can choose a picture of a suspicious message or letter to check.
